_doc: Approach cameras for every interactable (tools/tests/test_interactable_facing.gd --cams): cam_pos is the eye (1.65 m over the navmesh, 2.75 m out on the open side when it fits), look_at the object's centre ~1.1 m up. capture_sets are the same cameras in data/gravelight/capture_cams.json's set format (pos = feet, yaw 0 = -Z, positive turns toward -X, pitch): paste a set into that file to shoot it with tools_src/capture.gd --set=<name>.
